clog-1: Amanzi kwindlu yangasese akehli kwaphela kwaye ayaphuphuma
clog-2: Into yangaphandle (iwipe emanzi, ibrashi yamazinyo, isiciko) iwele kwindlu yangasese
clog-3: Isinki yasekhitshini iyanuka kwaye amanzi ayadibana ayemi
clog-4: Amanzi ayaphuphuma kumbhobho ophantsi kwesinki okanye kwisefa yomgangatho
clog-5: Isefa yomgangatho wegumbi lokuhlambela ivalwe ziinwele kwaye iyaphuphuma
clog-6: Umbhobho wokukhupha amanzi kwigumbi lokuhlambela iimpahla / ebhalkhonini ukhupha ugwebu namanzi
clog-7: Umbhobho omkhulu welindle okanye umngxuma welindle wesakhiwo uvaliwe
clog-8: Kufuneka uhlolo lwemibhobho kusetyenziswa ikhamera ye-endoscope
clog-9: Kufuneka ukucocwa kombhobho ngoxinzelelo oluphezulu lwamanzi
clog-10: Iingxaki zombhobho odibanisa itanki yogutyulo nokubuyela kwamanzi ngasemva
clog-11: Umbhobho wokulahla ukutya uvalwe ngamafutha aqinileyo
clog-12: Ukucocwa kwendawo yokubamba amafutha kwirestyu kunye nokuvula imibhobho
leak-1: Amanzi ayavuza okanye anyakamisa isilingi/udonga lwangaphantsi
leak-2: Imebha yamanzi iyajikeleza nokuba akukho manzi asetyenziswayo
leak-3: Iphepha lodonga, umgangatho wamaplanga, okanye imethi ifumile kwaye inekhula
leak-5: Isitywina esisezantsi kwindlu yangasese okanye izifakelo zetanki ziyavuza
leak-6: Umbhobho wamanzi ogqabhukileyo ngenxa yengqele yasebusika okanye imitha yamanzi ekhenkcezileyo
leak-7: Amanzi anomhlwa amdaka okanye anentshila aphuma kwiitepu
leak-8: Imibhobho yebhoyila okanye ivalve yokufudumeza iyavuza
leak-9: Ukungena kwamanzi emvula kwiintanda zangaphandle okanye kwizitywina zefestile
leak-10: Kufuneka ukufunyanwa kokuvuza okuncinci kusetyenziswa izixhobo ze-acoustic/irhasi
leak-11: Uxinzelelo lwamanzi luphantsi kakhulu, kufuneka kufakwe impompo yokonyusa uxinzelelo
leak-12: Ukutshintshwa ngokupheleleyo kwemibhobho emidala nokuthintela amanzi kumgangatho wegumbi lokuhlambela
bl-1: Ibhoyila ivuliwe, kodwa igumbi alifudumali kwaphela
bl-2: Amanzi ashushu awaphumi xa uhlamba, kuphuma amanzi abandayo kuphela
bl-3: Ikhowudi yempazamo iyadanyaza kwi-thermostat yegumbi yangaphakathi
bl-4: Amanzi ayavuza ngaphakathi kwebhoyila okanye kwimibhobho esezantsi
bl-5: Ingxolo enkulu yokungqubuzana okanye ukugquma xa ibhoyila iqala
bl-6: Ivumba lerhasi okanye umsi ophuma kumbhobho ungena egumbini
bl-7: Impompo yokujikeleza ayisebenzi; kuvakala amanzi kodwa akushushu
bl-8: Kucelwa ikowuti yebhoyila yerhasi entsha ye-condensing ehambelana nokusingqongileyo
bl-9: I-thermostat yegumbi ngalinye yophukile okanye isilawuli se-zone asisebenzi
bl-10: Kufuneka kuhlanjululwe imibhobho yokufudumeza kwaye kukhutshwe nomoya
bl-11: Ukuhlolwa nokulungiswa kwebhoyila ye-oli / yombane / ye-pellet
bl-12: Ukunyibilikisa imibhobho yebhoyila engkhenkcezileyo nokufakela kwakhona isikhuseli-banda
clean-1: Ukucoca indlu phambi kokungena kwi-studio/officetel (Ukubulala iintsholongwane ngokupheleleyo)
clean-2: Ukucoca nzulu amanqatha kwisitovu sasekhitshini/i-hood nesinki
clean-3: Ukucoca ukungunda phakathi kweetayile zegumbi lokuhlambela, ikalika kunye nendlu yangasese
clean-4: Ukususa uthuli kwiifreyim zeefestile, umnatha wokhuselo nokucoca iiglasi
clean-5: Ukucoca ngaphakathi kwefriji ngomphunga ukubulala iintsholongwane nokususa amavumba
clean-6: Ukukhulula i-air conditioner ukucoca ifilitha kunye nokungunda kwizipholisi
clean-7: Ukukhulula ibhabhu yomatshini wokuhlamba impahla ukuyicoca ngokunzulu nokususa amakhwekhwe
clean-8: Ukukrwela umgangatho ngomatshini, ukususa amabala kunye nokugquma nge-wax ekhuselayo
clean-9: Ukususa amakhalane kumatrasi / kwisofa yelaphu nokucoca nzulu ngolwelo
clean-10: Ukucoca indlu egcwele inkunkuma (Ukulahla inkunkuma eninzi nokuphelisa amavumba)
clean-11: Ukucoca emva kokwakha (Ukususa uthuli lwesamente namachaphaza epeyinti)
clean-12: Ukususa uboya/ivumba lezilwanyana zasekhaya nokutshiza i-phytoncide eco-friendly
h-1: I-studio efikelelekayo enemali ephantsi yediphozithi ye-1M~3M KRW
h-2: Iflethi evulelekileyo kubanini bamakhadi obhaliso basemzini kunye nee-visa ezisemthethweni
h-3: Izinto zonke zifakiwe (umatshini wokuhlamba, ifriji, i-A/C, isitovu/i-induction zibandakanyiwe)
h-4: Indawo yokuhlala yexesha elifutshane (iinyanga ezi-3 ukuya kwezi-6) istudiyo/igosiwon
h-5: Indlu enamagumbi amabini okanye amathathu yokuhlala noogxa/usapho
h-6: Ukuhamba ngaphantsi kwemizuzu emi-5 ukuya kwisitishi sikamasipala okanye sebhasi
h-7: Ixabiso lokugcina nendawo ephantsi nengafihlisiyo yokusetyenziswa kombane namanzi
h-8: Indawo yokupaka kunye nelifti zikhona kwisakhiwo esitsha sale mihla
h-9: Indawo yokuhlala evumela izilwanyana zasekhaya (izinja, iikati zivunyelwe)
h-10: Ukunikezela kwangethuba ngerenti & noncedo lokubuyiselwa kwediphozithi
bank-1: Ukuphelekwa xa uvula iakhawunti yebhanki nge-ARC / Ipaspoti
bank-2: Isicelo sekhadi le-debit elinomsebenzi wokuhamba we-T-money
bank-3: Ukuseta ibhanki yeselula kwi-smartphone, isiqinisekiso sedijithali kunye ne-OTP
bank-4: Ukunyusa umda wokuthumela imali kumazwe aphesheya & nokubhalisa iakhawunti yomamkeli
bank-5: Ukukhupha kwakhona incwadi yebhanki/ikhadi elilahlekileyo nokushicilela iingxelo zentengiselwano
bank-6: Ukuseta kwakhona iimpazamo zegama lokugqitha zamatyeli ama-5 nokuvula iakhawunti emisiweyo
bank-7: Ukumisela iakhawunti yomrholo nokuseta ukutsalwa kwemali ngokuzenzekelayo
bank-8: Ukujonga ukufaneleka kwekhadi letyala labaphambukeli noncedo lwamaxwebhu
insur-1: Ukutshekishwa kokufaneleka kwi-Inshurensi yezeMpilo kaZwelonke nokuphelekwa ekubhaliseni
insur-2: I-inshurensi enyanzelekileyo yabasebenzi bangaphandle (isiqinisekiso sokumka / iingozi)
insur-3: Ukubonisana nge-inshurensi yonyango yabucala kunye nentlawulo yokulaliswa esibhedlele
insur-4: Uthelekiso nokuseta i-inshurensi enyanzelekileyo nebanzi yemoto / isithuthuthu
insur-5: Isikhokelo sokufaka ibango le-inshurensi kunye nokuguqulelwa kwamaxwebhu onyango
insur-6: Uhlengahlengiso lwe-inshurensi ngenxa yokutshintsha kwe-visa nokubuyiselwa kwexabiso lokurhoxisa
insur-7: Ukubonisana ngecebo le-inshurensi yamazinyo, umhlaza kunye notyando olukhulu
insur-8: Ukukhangela nokufumana iinzuzo ze-inshurensi ezingabekwanga amabango ngaphambi kokugoduka
job-1: Ukwenza iimpahla / imveliso yasefektri nokudibanisa (indawo yokulala ibonelelwe)
job-2: Umncedisi wasekhitshini kwirestyu / Umququzeleli wetafile / UmPheki (Abaphambukeli bamkelekile)
job-3: Ukwakha / Ukuchwela ngaphakathi kwesakhiwo, i-rebar, umbane kunye nemibhobho yamanzi
job-4: Urhwebo / Indawo yokugcina iimpahla engenayo nephumayo, ukutshayela i-forklift nokupakisha
job-5: Ukutolika / Ulawulo lweofisi / Ingcali yentengiso yehlabathi
job-6: Uphononongo lwekhontrakthi yengqesho (Umvuzo, iiyure zokusebenza, i-inshurensi zentlalo ezi-4 eziphambili)
job-7: Imivuzo engagawulwanga, iimali zokushiya umsebenzi kunye nokukhapha kudliwano-ndlebe lweengxabano zomsebenzi
job-8: Kubaqeshi: Ukuqesha abasebenzi basemzini abasemthethweni, abakhutheleyo nabafanelekileyo
hosp-1: Ukubhukisha idinga kunye nokungena kwisibhedlele jikelele/seyunivesithi
hosp-2: Ukhathalelo lwamazinyo anomngxuma, unyango lweengcambu, ukukhutshwa kwamazinyo kunye nokutolikwa
hosp-3: Ukutolikwa kophulaphulo lwamathambo, iintlungu zomqolo, kunye nonyango lomzimba
hosp-4: Amayeza angaphakathi / Ugqirha weendlebe, impumlo nomqala, umkhuhlane, ukudumba kwesisu nokutolika i-endoscopy
hosp-5: Uviwo lwe-OB-GYN / Urology kunye nothethwano oluyimfihlo lukagqirha
hosp-6: Ingcaciso yengxelo yohlolo lwezempilo lwesizwe ngolwimi lwenkobe
hosp-7: Ukukhapha kunye noncedo kwigumbi likaxakeka (ER) ebusuku/ngeempelaveki
hosp-8: Idosi yayeza lasekhemesti, izilumkiso kunye nemiyalelo
mob-1: Ukwenza i-USIM yebhajethi ifumaneke kubaphambukeli enesiqinisekiso esipheleleyo sesazisi
mob-2: Ukutshaja ngokukhawuleza kwekhadi le-SIM elihlawulelwa kwangaphambili kunye nezicwangciso zedatha ezingenamda
mob-3: Ubhaliso olutsha kuthungelwano olukhulu (SKT/KT/LGU+) kunye nokuphuculwa kwee-smartphone zamva nje
mob-4: Ufakelo lwe-intanethi ye-fiber ekhawulezayo kunye ne-Giga Wi-Fi yegumbi elinye/yekhaya
mob-5: Ukusombulula ukunqunyanyiswa kwamatyala angafikelelanga, ukutshintshwa kobunini kunye nokutshintsha inombolo (MNP)
mob-6: Ukufaka usetyenziso lokuqinisekisa isazisi se-PASS kunye noncedo lokuqinisekisa ngefowuni
mob-7: Umonakalo wesikrini, ukutshintshwa kwebhetri kunye nokukhapha kwiziko lenkonzo elisemthethweni
mob-8: Usetyenziso lokufowunela kumazwe ngamazwe ngexabiso eliphantsi kunye nokutshaja ikhuphoni yedatha
